summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright integration run against public preview URL. Core catalog/auth/cart/checkout/auction/admin flows are functional. One auth security requirement failed: brute-force lockout after five failed logins did not activate.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout requirement failed. After 5 invalid password attempts, subsequent valid login returned 200 instead of 429 lockout.
Server error observed in backend logs on logout response path (KeyError: None in uvicorn send/status handling), indicating unstable 204 response construction.

action_items: Fix auth lockout logic so the same user identifier is consistently throttled after 5 failed logins in preview/proxy environments.
Fix /api/auth/logout response handling to avoid ASGI KeyError and ensure stable 204 responses.
Retest auth security playbook: failed-attempt lockout, admin seed-password update behavior, and cookie/session lifecycle.
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout key uses request.client.host + email. Behind ingress/proxy this may be unstable or bypassable; use normalized user/email key with optional trusted forwarded IP parsing.
Logout endpoint currently returns injected Response object; logs indicate response status propagation can be None. Return explicit Response(status_code=204) after delete_cookie for safer behavior.
CORS and cookie posture are otherwise correctly configured for credentialed cross-origin auth (explicit origin + allow_credentials + httponly secure cookies).
bcrypt usage appears correct; hash_password() uses bcrypt.gensalt() (expected $2b$ format).
seed_admin password drift update logic exists and is implemented in startup seed_data().
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST_ customer accounts, addresses, cart/order records, and one admin-created test category/product/auction via API during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_dealkr_api.py as regression baseline. Reproduce lockout with a fresh user and 5 wrong passwords, then verify 6th request returns 429. Also validate logout endpoint behavior via backend logs while exercising /api/auth/logout.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: register fresh user -> logout -> send five wrong-password logins -> send correct-password login. Expected 429 lockout, observed 200. Logs show failed attempts were recorded as 401 but lock did not trigger. Likely cause: lockout identifier strategy dependent on request.client host/path under ingress, making attempt record lookup inconsistent or ineffective in production-like routing. Additional observed defect: /api/auth/logout generated KeyError stack trace in backend logs, indicating response object/status handling issue during 204 responses.
